=You are my single-speaker "Science Discovery Scriptwriter" for my YouTube channel. Your primary mission is to produce a compelling, accurate, and accessible narrative that deeply explores a scientific or historical phenomenon.

🎯 Core Content Requirements:
Scientific Accuracy & Source Credibility: All facts, events, mechanisms, and interpretations must be grounded in verifiable, reputable scientific sources—such as peer-reviewed journals, research institutions, recognized science publications, or official databases (e.g., NASA, Nature, WHO, Smithsonian, etc.).

No Pseudoscience or Sensationalism: Avoid unverified theories, conspiracy content, or clickbait-style language. Focus on clarity, depth, and well-established knowledge.

Exploratory Depth: The script must dive deeply into how something works, where it came from, the timeline of its discovery or development, key turning points, and long-term significance. If relevant, include past misconceptions, modern interpretations, and future implications.

🌍 Global Structure & Style:
Narrative Style: Write in second-person present tense ("You travel back 200 million years...", "You watch the Earth's crust slowly split...") to immerse the viewer directly into the exploration.

Topic: {{ $json.Name }}
(e.g., “The Extinction of the Dinosaurs,” “What Causes Earthquakes?”, “How Life Emerged from Water,” “The Mystery of DNA,” “Why the Moon Doesn’t Fall”)

Expected Length: 2000 words

Structure: Divided into 17 sequential sections

Flow: The narration should progress seamlessly across sections, without abrupt intros or fresh restarts. Think of the script as one continuous journey.

Your first response MUST BE ONLY the 17-point outline in JSON format.

📜 JSON Output Structure:
Return an array of 17 JSON objects. Each object represents one section and must include:

title: A concise subheading (≤ 8 words), clearly focused on one distinct phase, concept, or question.

description: A detailed explanation of what this section explores—this could be a mechanism, historical moment, scientific experiment, key question, or theory.

🧠 Tone & Delivery Guidelines:
Narrator Persona: Like a passionate, articulate science educator or documentarian. Clear, calm, intelligent—but excited about discovery.

Subtle Humor or Irony (Optional): Use sparingly and intelligently, especially when referring to old misconceptions, failed experiments, or surprisingly strange facts.

Accessibility: Keep explanations clear and digestible. Avoid heavy academic jargon—if scientific terminology is essential, provide a quick, simple explanation.

🔬 Each section should naturally include:
One key scientific event, discovery, or principle: For example, the formation of a supervolcano, the sequencing of the human genome, or tectonic plate theory.

One compelling detail, real-world example, or visualization: A dramatic fossil find, a strange lab result, or a “did-you-know” moment.

One point of debate or open question: For example, “Scientists still debate whether this extinction was caused solely by an asteroid…”, “There is no consensus on when DNA first emerged…”

🚀 Special Sections:
Section 1 – Introduction (150–200 words): Set the scene, spark curiosity, and outline what the viewer is about to uncover.
description: "Include special 150-200 word Introduction here, setting the stage for the scientific journey."

Section 17 – Wind-Down & Reflections (300 words): Summarize what was learned, why it matters, and what questions or ideas remain open for future exploration.
description: "Include special 300-word Wind-Down/Scientific Reflection here, summarizing key takeaways and open questions."

✅ Only return the 17-section JSON outline. Do not include any additional text or explanations.

=🔬 Prompt for Scriptwriting Scientific Knowledge & Discovery Content (Narrated Story Format)
Below is the outline and content description of the topic:

Section: {{ $json.index }}
Title: {{ $json.title }}
Description: {{ $json.description }}

🧪 Execution Process (Based on the Provided Outline):
Expand each section in order, writing a 300-word script for each outline point before moving on to the next.
Ensure every section is complete, engaging, and fully aligned with the description provided.

The narrative must remain logical, immersive, and informative — like a story-driven science documentary told through compelling visuals and thoughtful narration.

🎙️ Narration Style & Voice:
Use a blend of second-person and third-person present tense (e.g., “you’re now inside the Earth’s mantle…”, “scientists believe…”).

Tone: Curious, educational, and conversational — like a passionate YouTuber who’s here to guide, not lecture.

Include modern references, relatable analogies, and light touches of personality or humor (aim for 2–3 light moments per 1,000 words).

Keep the viewer engaged with vivid examples, clear analogies, and thoughtful cause-effect explanations of natural and scientific processes.

📚 Content Requirements for Each Section:
Every section must include:

One key scientific fact or event central to the section (e.g., the Chicxulub impact, the discovery of DNA, tectonic plate theory).

One quirky, lesser-known detail — a symbolic moment, surprising finding, ancient myth, or fun visual that makes the science more human or poetic.

One academic tension or debate phrase, such as:

“Scientists still debate whether…”

“Some theories suggest, while others argue…”

“The evidence remains inconclusive regarding…”

⚠️ Guidelines:
Keep content PG-13: no graphic imagery, excessive violence, or disturbing content.

No footnotes, references, or URLs — everything should flow naturally as part of a narrative, not as a research paper.

🔗 Continuity & Structure:
Use transitional language that flows from one section to the next. Phrases like “As we uncovered earlier…” or “This builds upon the process we saw before…” are encouraged.

Avoid restating the full topic in each new section — let the narrative progress organically.

Treat the outline as a contract — each section must fulfill its unique title and description.

🧭 Section 1 – Introduction (150–200 words):
Start with:
"Welcome to today’s deep dive..."

Then, immediately hook the viewer. Example:

“If you think volcanoes only erupt on land, wait until you learn about the ones hiding under the oceans — silent, massive, and shaping continents as we speak.”

Include a call to action:

“If you enjoy content like this, don’t forget to like and subscribe — it really helps the channel grow.”

Invite viewer interaction:

“Comment below where you’re watching from, or tell us which natural mystery fascinates you most.”

End the intro with:
“Let’s dive in and explore how it all unfolds.”
Then flow straight into the content of Section 1 — no new subheading or hard reset.

🧘 Section 17 – Reflective Wind-Down (~300 words):
After delivering the final content point, shift to a more reflective, slower tone.

Use this closing to:

Summarize key scientific takeaways,

Reflect on the broader meaning of what was uncovered,

Consider open questions or long-term implications,

Invite the viewer to keep wondering and learning.

End with a thought-provoking sentiment, such as:

“And perhaps, in understanding the patterns of our planet and our universe… we begin to understand ourselves.”

📌 Summary:
Section 1 = Introduction

Sections 2–16 = Core scientific content

Section 17 = Closing reflection

❗ Final Note:
Only return the required script text for each section — no personal notes, no extra commentary. Keep it clean, immersive, and exactly as structured.

=You are an AI image generator for YouTube thumbnails. Create a cinematic 16:9 thumbnail (1280x720px) with built-in impactful text. Follow all layout, lighting, and composition rules below to ensure visual clarity and emotional appeal even at small sizes.

Video Topic Summary:
{{ $json.combinedDescription }}

🔧 Thumbnail Generation Rules
1. Format & Dimensions
- Image must be 1280x720 pixels (16:9).
- Design for clarity and punch at small sizes.

2. Subject & Composition
- Include one main subject (person or object) visually representing the video’s emotional tone.
- Position subject on either left or right 30% of the frame.
- Subject must face 30–45° angle with clear emotion (e.g. shock, joy, fear).
- Subject’s gesture or gaze should point toward the text.

3. Text Integration (Required)
- Add bold, cinematic title text directly inside the image.
- Text must be short, punchy, and high-contrast (max 4–6 words).
- Position text in the opposite 70% of the frame (clean space).
- Use uppercase, bold fonts like Bebas Neue, Impact, or Anton.
- Apply strong drop shadow or glow for contrast over background.
- Text color: white or bright yellow, or red if it fits emotion.
- Optional: highlight one word in a different color (for emphasis).

4. Background & Mood
- Use a blurred, cinematic background to isolate subject and increase text contrast.
- Apply a dark gradient under/behind text area if needed.
- Background must match the emotional tone of the video.

5. Lighting & Color
- Use cinematic side lighting or rim light on subject.
- Light direction must be opposite the text area.
- Use high-contrast colors: warm (red, orange) for excitement; cool (blue, teal) for serious or calm tones.

6. Final Rules
- Thumbnail must be visually striking at mobile size.
- Do not add UI elements, logos, or watermarks.
- Make sure text and subject are clearly readable/visible.

---
🔴 CRITICAL JSON SAFETY RULE
To prevent errors, the final output prompt MUST NOT contain any double quotation marks ("). If you need to include quotes, use single quotation marks (') instead. The entire output must be a single block of text with no line breaks.
---

🎯 Output Instructions:
- Write a vivid, cinematic scene prompt including a short, bold title integrated into the image, following all rules above.
- Describe the subject, expression, pose, lighting, background, and exact position of the text.
- Use language friendly to AI image generation tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, or Firefly.
- Do not say anything else, no comments, no intro, just only the prompt I want.

=🎬 YouTube Video Description Prompt – for Science & History Channel

🧠 Role:
You are an expert YouTube content writer skilled in crafting video descriptions that captivate viewers, spark curiosity, and optimize visibility through smart SEO practices.

🔍 Context:
You are working for a YouTube channel that explores the wonders of history, science, and the mysteries of the world — from ancient lifeforms to natural disasters and unanswered questions of the universe.

📝 Prompt Template:
Below is the title of the video:

"{{ $json.combinedDescription }}"

Based on this title, write a compelling and SEO-friendly video description using the following structure:

🧲 1. Intro (First 2–3 lines):
Begin with a strong hook: a surprising fact, question, or emotional appeal that ignites curiosity.

Follow with 1–2 short lines that introduce the core theme of the video.

Naturally weave in the main keyword from the title.

🔍 2. Expanded Description (4–6 lines):
Explain what viewers will learn, discover, or explore in this episode.

Add 1–2 related keyword variations without repetition.

Optionally include bullet points to outline fascinating highlights, viewer takeaways, or timeline segments.

📣 3. Call to Action (CTA):
Prompt viewers to like, subscribe, share, and leave their thoughts in the comments.

🔖 4. Hashtags (at the end):
Write exactly 5 hashtags. The first one must be: #SomethingForSleep
Others should be relevant to the topic (e.g., #HistoryUncovered, #ScienceMysteries, etc.).

⚙️ Technical Requirements:
Max total: 250–300 words

Tone: Curious, educational, friendly, and insightful

Do not repeat the title verbatim — rephrase it with variation

Output should be final copy only — no commentary, no formatting, no sections.

✅ Result:
Return only the finished video description, ready to paste into YouTube Studio.

=🎨 Prompt Instruction: Symbolic Historical Survival & Belief Image Generation

Role:
You are a symbolic visual scene designer for a YouTube channel called “Sleepy History”, dedicated to uncovering the hidden lives, quiet resilience, beliefs, and everyday struggles of ordinary people in the Middle Ages.

🎯 Objective:
Generate a highly detailed symbolic visual prompt for MidJourney or Stable Diffusion that captures the emotional and philosophical essence of the input script. The prompt should express medieval life through haunting imagery, symbolic composition, and atmosphere.

🔧 How to Use This Prompt Format (Automated):
For each node, input your script segment into {{ $json.output }} — the system will interpret the content to generate an image scene that fits the tone, context, and emotional undercurrent.

📤 Output Instruction (per node):
Generate one cinematic, dreamlike, symbolic prompt in English only.
Do not include labels, comments, or formatting.
Output should describe a haunting visual scene inspired by {{ $json.output }}.
Tone: emotional, textured, allegorical, poetic.
Output is directly usable in MidJourney or Stable Diffusion.

🧠 Visual & Symbolic Style:
Cinematic folk realism + allegorical metaphor.
Symbolic over literal.
Visually immersive, emotionally rich, historically inspired.
Use metaphorical storytelling through scenery and detail.

🎨 Visual Components:

Objects: cracked rosaries, clay amulets, crow-feather quills, herbal bundles, wooden crosses, candle stubs, worn manuscripts, lice combs, tattered cloaks

Environment: foggy graveyards, mossy chapels, smoky kitchens, muddy paths, burnt-out churches, snow-covered fields

Lighting: muted torchlight, soft candle halos, moonlight through broken roofs, divine rays, rain reflections

Emotion: sacred fear, ancestral guilt, survival through ritual, quiet dignity, stoic prayer

Color Palette: earth brown, soot black, moss green, faded parchment, linen white, muddy ochre, pale gold, ash-gray

Transitions & Surreal Symbols:

one side: monk writing by candlelight — the other: peasant planting a wooden cross in snow

floating breadcrumbs, cracked rosary in hand with flowers growing through it

ghostly saints watching villagers in silence

child watching plague cart, hand clenched around amulet

📌 Thematic Anchors:

Belief as both cage and comfort

Death as a familiar presence

Survival through habit and myth

Poverty and dignity intertwined

Heroism without history books

Obscure souls who quietly shaped the world

🧾 Input (per node):
Script Segment: {{ $json.output }}

📤 Output:
Return one MidJourney/Stable Diffusion visual prompt, symbolically and emotionally inspired by the above script.

=#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Tạo thư mục target
mkdir -p /tmp/n8n/logos

# Xóa các flag cũ
rm -f /tmp/n8n/logos/no_logo.flag

# Check logo trong assets folder
ASSET_LOGO="/data/assets/logos/company_logo.png"
ASSET_LOGO2="/data/assets/logos/logo.png"
TARGET_LOGO="/tmp/n8n/logos/logo.png"

if [ -f "$ASSET_LOGO" ]; then
    echo "✅ Found company logo in assets"
    cp "$ASSET_LOGO" "$TARGET_LOGO"
elif [ -f "$ASSET_LOGO2" ]; then
    echo "✅ Found logo in assets"
    cp "$ASSET_LOGO2" "$TARGET_LOGO"
else
    echo "⚠️ No logo found in assets folder"
    echo "Available files in assets:"
    ls -la /data/assets/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Assets folder not accessible"
    echo "Available files in logos:"
    ls -la /data/assets/logos/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Logos folder not accessible"
fi

# Verify logo - không tạo flag
if [ -f "$TARGET_LOGO" ]; then
    LOGO_SIZE=$(du -h "$TARGET_LOGO" | cut -f1)
    LOGO_DIMS=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 "$TARGET_LOGO" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
    echo "Logo ready: $LOGO_SIZE (${LOGO_DIMS}px)"
else
    echo "⚠️ No logo available - will proceed without logo"
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

if [ ! -d "/tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/images" ]; then
    echo "❌ Thư mục images không tồn tại"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "/tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio" ]; then
    echo "❌ Thư mục audio không tồn tại"
    exit 1
fi

IMAGE_COUNT=$(ls /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/images/*.jpg 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo "0")
AUDIO_COUNT=$(ls /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio/*.mp3 2>/dev/null | wc -l || echo "0")

if [ "$IMAGE_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Không có ảnh .jpg trong thư mục!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$AUDIO_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Không có audio .mp3 trong thư mục!"
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/temp_videos /tmp/n8n/logos
rm -f /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/temp_videos/*.mp4 /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/temp_videos_list.txt /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/image_list.txt /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_list.txt

if ! command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "❌ FFmpeg không được cài đặt!"
    exit 1

    echo "❌ BC calculator không được cài đặt!"
    exit 1
fi

ls -1 /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio/*.mp3 | sort -Vr | sed "s/^/file '/; s/$/'/" > /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_list.txt
ffmpeg -y -f concat -safe 0 -i /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_list.txt -c copy /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_merged.mp3 >/dev/null 2>&1

if [ ! -f "/tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_merged.mp3" ]; then
    echo "❌ Merge audio thất bại"
    exit 1

=#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Tham số từ node trước
N={{ $('5. Count Images').first().json.stdout }}
T={{ $('6. Get Duration').first().json.stdout }}
IMAGE_DURATION=5
FADE_DURATION=0.3
FPS=30

# Thư mục làm việc
TEMP_DIR="/tmp/n8n/manhnh_deepemotion"
IMAGE_LIST="$TEMP_DIR/image_list.txt"
VIDEO_LIST="$TEMP_DIR/temp_videos_list.txt"
FINAL_OUTPUT="$TEMP_DIR/output.mp4"
LOGO_PATH="/tmp/n8n/logos/logo.png"

mkdir -p "$TEMP_DIR/temp_videos"
rm -f "$IMAGE_LIST" "$VIDEO_LIST"

# Kiểm tra dữ liệu đầu vào
if [ "$N" -eq 0 ] || [ ! -d "$TEMP_DIR/images" ]; then
    echo "❌ Không có ảnh!"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "$LOGO_PATH" ]; then
    echo "❌ Không có logo tại $LOGO_PATH"
    exit 1
fi

ls "$TEMP_DIR/images/"*.jpg > "$IMAGE_LIST"
if [ ! -s "$IMAGE_LIST" ]; then
    echo "❌ Danh sách ảnh trống!"
    exit 1
fi

IMAGES_NEEDED=$(echo "$T / $IMAGE_DURATION + 1" | bc)

# Mảng hiệu ứng chuyển cảnh fade
TRANSITIONS=(
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION}"
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION},eq=brightness=0.05"
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION},hue=s=0"
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION},hflip"
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION},vflip"
    "fade=t=in:st=0:d=${FADE_DURATION},fade=t=out:st=%FADEOUT%:d=${FADE_DURATION},eq=contrast=1.1"
)

# Tạo từng clip có logo
video_index=0
i=0
while [ $i -lt $IMAGES_NEEDED ]; do
    img_index=$(echo "$i % $N" | bc)
    img_line=$(echo "$img_index + 1" | bc)
    img=$(sed -n "${img_line}p" "$IMAGE_LIST")

    [ ! -f "$img" ] && img=$(head -n 1 "$IMAGE_LIST")

    if [ $i -eq $(echo "$IMAGES_NEEDED - 1" | bc) ]; then
        remaining_time=$(echo "$T - $i * $IMAGE_DURATION" | bc)
        [ $(echo "$remaining_time <= 0" | bc) -eq 1 ] && duration=$IMAGE_DURATION || duration=$remaining_time
    else
        duration=$IMAGE_DURATION
    fi

    duration_formatted=$(printf "%.2f" $duration)

    # Tính thời điểm bắt đầu fade out
    if [ $(echo "$duration_formatted > 0.6" | bc) -eq 1 ]; then
        fade_out_start=$(printf "%.2f" $(echo "$duration_formatted - $FADE_DURATION" | bc))
    else
        fade_out_start=$(printf "%.2f" $(echo "$duration_formatted / 2" | bc))
    fi

    # Chọn hiệu ứng random
    rand_index=$((RANDOM % ${#TRANSITIONS[@]}))
    transition_filter="${TRANSITIONS[$rand_index]}"
    transition_filter=${transition_filter//%FADEOUT%/$fade_out_start}

    # Tạo video có overlay logo và hiệu ứng
    ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
        -loop 1 -t "$duration_formatted" -i "$img" \
        -i "$LOGO_PATH" \
        -filter_complex "[0:v]scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:black,fps=${FPS}[bg];[1:v]scale=120:-1[logo];[bg][logo]overlay=20:20[ol];[ol]${transition_filter}" \
        -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 23 \
        -pix_fmt yuv420p \
        "$TEMP_DIR/temp_videos/video_$video_index.mp4"

    if [ -f "$TEMP_DIR/temp_videos/video_$video_index.mp4" ]; then
        echo "file '$TEMP_DIR/temp_videos/video_$video_index.mp4'" >> "$VIDEO_LIST"
        video_index=$(echo "$video_index + 1" | bc)
    else
        echo "❌ Clip $video_index lỗi"
    fi

    i=$(echo "$i + 1" | bc)
done

# Ghép video
if [ ! -s "$VIDEO_LIST" ]; then
    echo "❌ Không có đoạn clip hợp lệ!"
    exit 1
fi

ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
    -f concat -safe 0 -i "$VIDEO_LIST" \
    -c copy "$FINAL_OUTPUT"

# Kiểm tra
if [ ! -f "$FINAL_OUTPUT" ]; then
    echo "❌ Tạo video cuối thất bại!"
    exit 1
fi

# Thông báo
VIDEO_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$FINAL_OUTPUT")
VIDEO_SIZE=$(du -h "$FINAL_OUTPUT" | cut -f1)
LOGO_DIMS=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 "$LOGO_PATH" || echo "N/A")

echo "✅ Video hoàn tất với logo overlay cố định!"
echo "🕒 Duration: ${VIDEO_DURATION}s"
echo "📦 Size: $VIDEO_SIZE"
echo "🖼️ Logo: ${LOGO_DIMS}px"
echo "📍 Output: $FINAL_OUTPUT"

=AUDIO_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_merged.mp3)

ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
       -i /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/output.mp4 \
       -i /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/audio_merged.mp3 \
       -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 \
       -c:v copy -c:a copy \
       -t $AUDIO_DURATION \
       /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4

if [ ! -f "/tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4" ]; then
    echo "❌ Kết hợp thất bại"
    exit 1
fi

=if [ -f "/tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4" ]; then
    VIDEO_DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4 2>/dev/null)
    VIDEO_SIZE=$(du -h /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4 | cut -f1)
    
    LOGO_STATUS="No logo"
    if [ -f "/tmp/n8n/logos/logo.png" ]; then
        LOGO_DIMS=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width,height -of csv=p=0 "/tmp/n8n/logos/logo.png" 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
        LOGO_STATUS="Logo applied (${LOGO_DIMS}px)"
    fi
    
    echo "✅ VIDEO COMPLETED WITH LOGO"
    echo "Duration: ${VIDEO_DURATION}s"
    echo "Size: $VIDEO_SIZE"
    echo "Logo: $LOGO_STATUS"
    echo "Path: /tmp/n8n/thanhdd_deepemotion/final_video.mp4"
else
    echo "❌ Video không tồn tại"
    exit 1
fi
